description: USD per million tokens, keyed <runtime>/<model> where <model> is the models.json name; <runtime>/* is that runtime's default. This is the only price table: models.json carries none. An active model with no entry is refused at launch and cannot run under a USD budget. "unverified": true marks an entry not yet checked against the vendor's published prices; launch warns on it. The openai-compat default assumes a self-hosted endpoint; a hosted one needs its own entry. limits cap every harness-budgeted lane, priced or not.
